Vendor snapshots used only by tool/compile_blocklist.dart.
The running app never reads this folder and never downloads lists.

easylist_adservers.txt, easyprivacy_trackingservers.txt, and
easyprivacy_trackingservers_international.txt are copies of EasyList /
EasyPrivacy filter fragments (GPLv3 / CC BY-SA 3.0). extra_mobile_*.txt
are additional mobile advertising, analytics, attribution, and profiling
hosts maintained in this repository.
